presumption_rule: Known public values are presumed exposed to the research environment unless a verifiable quarantine predates the derivation. Hashing an exposed payload establishes pre-unsealing custody rather than pre-exposure blindness.
scoring_rule: Issue 639 performs at most one physical comparison for the whole campaign and records its exposure class. Exploratory rows are catalog-only and ineligible for scoring. An exposed retrospective agreement remains retrospective compatibility and cannot become a surviving differentiator.

surfaces.description: Particle Data Group particle listings: pole masses, widths, branching fractions, and mixing parameters.
CODATA recommended values of the fundamental physical constants.
Published cosmic microwave background angular power spectra, maps, and derived likelihood products.
Gravitational-wave transient catalogs and ringdown parameter estimates.
Global three-flavor neutrino oscillation fit parameters and ordering statistics.
Precision quantum-electrodynamic dimensionless ratios, including magnetic-moment anomalies.

historical_search_note: Historical OPH searches against the same public targets remain in the multiplicity ledger and count toward trials corrections at scoring time.
